analysis.narrativeEn:

· RSI trajectory (34.8→42.3) + Entering the oversold escape zone, attempting to recover into the neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-8183.9041→2057.7369) + Diagnosing improvement, attempting to break out of the negative zone.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,089,000 KRW) + Close to the 5-day low (1,044,000 KRW), acting as a psychological support.
· Swing resistance (1,317,000 KRW) + Lower than the 20-day high (1,587,000 KRW), with potential for trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low 1,044,000 KRW, 20-day low 1,044,000 KRW, 5-day high 1,212,000 KRW, 20-day high 1,587,000 KRW): No Higher Low formed, Lower High pattern confirmed, indicating a sideways market.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.04): Normal level compared to the 5-day average, indicating moderate confidence in the price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Accumulation phase, maintaining a wait-and-see approach until a clear direction is confirmed.
